plan.title: AD lesional vs control: Hallmark GSEA from DE results
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question asks only which hallmark pathways are enriched in the treated (AD lesional) vs control skin comparison, and a DESeq2 results table for that exact contrast (de_results.csv, 12000 genes x 8 columns, treated vs control) is already provided — so no differential expression re-run is planned, only enrichment on the delivered results, per the user's instruction to start from those results and use Python throughout. Step 1 builds the preranked gene list from de_results.csv using the DESeq2 Wald statistic (stat column) as the ranking metric — the grounded, uncertainty-scaled choice over the unshrunken log2FC or a signed p-value with ties — and states the contrast direction and reference level as delivered. Step 2 runs gseapy prerank GSEA against the MSigDB Hallmark human gene set collection (50 sets, 2026.1, symbols GMT) with the standard 15-500 gene set size window, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR, and a fixed seed. Step 3 collapses redundant leading-edge overlaps and produces the final report with the reproducibility record (collection version, rank metric, universe, size window) and the method-dependence caveat, all in Python. No new statistical test is fitted on the counts; the raw counts and metadata are not used because the results table already encodes the tested contrast.

steps.method: gseapy preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic with MSigDB Hallmark
Enrichment report with leading edge genes and reproducibility record
